fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Five stamps, and the sixth loaf is on us

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: A paper card, a linen bag and one loaf a week. This is how the club runs, from your first Friday to your free one.

default.title: Ask for a card
default.text: Pick one up at the till on Marsh Lane. It costs nothing and fits in a wallet.

default.title: Text us by Wednesday
default.text: Country sourdough, seeded rye or the baker's choice. Orders close at 6 pm.

default.title: We bake on Friday
default.text: Your loaf goes into the oven at 4 am with your name chalked on the board.

default.title: Pick it up warm
default.text: From 7:30 on Friday or Saturday. We stamp your card at the counter.

default.title: Bring the bag back
default.text: Hand in the linen bag next week and we fill it again. No paper, no plastic.

default.title: Sixth loaf on us
default.text: Five stamps earn a free loaf of your choice, and a fresh card to start again.
